name: Yolvex Vault 192 EGEO
description: Key Features Large Internal Capacity: Offers a spacious 1,752-litre storage volume, ideal for storing significant quantities of temperature-sensitive goods. Precise Temperature Control: Maintains a consistent holding temperature of -8°C, suitable for preserving perishable items, pharmaceuticals, or specialty foods. Humidity Regulation: Features a 38% relative humidity setpoint, optimizing storage conditions to prevent spoilage and maintain product quality. Eutectic-Buffered Film Technology: Utilizes advanced eutectic buffering for stable cooling performance, reducing temperature fluctuations and enhancing energy efficiency. Low Oxygen Atmosphere: Designed with a low-oxygen environment to extend shelf life, inhibit spoilage, and preserve freshness. Flexible Storage Organization: Equipped with 7 adjustable shelves to accommodate a variety of product sizes and storage needs. Main Benefits Extended Product Freshness: The combination of low temperature, controlled humidity, and low-oxygen storage helps maximize shelf life and maintain the integrity of stored goods. Consistent Performance: Eutectic-buffered film ensures reliable cooling, minimizing risk of temperature spikes that could damage sensitive items. Customizable Storage: Adjustable shelving allows for efficient organization and easy access to products, supporting streamlined inventory management. Energy Efficiency: Advanced insulation and cooling technology help lower operational costs by reducing energy consumption. Typical Use Cases and Outcomes Food Storage: Ideal for commercial kitchens, food distributors, and specialty food retailers needing reliable cold storage for meats, dairy, or prepared foods. Pharmaceuticals: Suitable for pharmacies and laboratories requiring precise temperature and humidity control for medications and biological samples. Floral and Botanical Storage: Maintains optimal conditions for florists or botanical suppliers to preserve freshness and reduce waste. Bulk Storage Needs: Perfect for businesses seeking large-capacity, controlled-environment storage for bulk perishable inventory. User-Focused Answers Durability: Built with high-quality materials and advanced insulation to ensure long-lasting, dependable operation in demanding environments. Ease of Use: Adjustable shelves and straightforward controls make setup and daily operation user-friendly. Compatibility: Designed to accommodate a wide range of product types and sizes, supporting diverse storage requirements. Value: Delivers reliable performance and energy savings, making it a cost-effective choice for businesses prioritizing product quality and operational efficiency. This cold storage unit is engineered to address the most common needs in commercial refrigeration, providing precise temperature and humidity control, ample storage space, and advanced preservation technology for a variety of industries.
description_html:
Key Features

  • Large Internal Capacity: Offers a spacious 1,752-litre storage volume, ideal for storing significant quantities of temperature-sensitive goods.
  • Precise Temperature Control: Maintains a consistent holding temperature of -8°C, suitable for preserving perishable items, pharmaceuticals, or specialty foods.
  • Humidity Regulation: Features a 38% relative humidity setpoint, optimizing storage conditions to prevent spoilage and maintain product quality.
  • Eutectic-Buffered Film Technology: Utilizes advanced eutectic buffering for stable cooling performance, reducing temperature fluctuations and enhancing energy efficiency.
  • Low Oxygen Atmosphere: Designed with a low-oxygen environment to extend shelf life, inhibit spoilage, and preserve freshness.
  • Flexible Storage Organization: Equipped with 7 adjustable shelves to accommodate a variety of product sizes and storage needs.

Main Benefits

  • Extended Product Freshness: The combination of low temperature, controlled humidity, and low-oxygen storage helps maximize shelf life and maintain the integrity of stored goods.
  • Consistent Performance: Eutectic-buffered film ensures reliable cooling, minimizing risk of temperature spikes that could damage sensitive items.
  • Customizable Storage: Adjustable shelving allows for efficient organization and easy access to products, supporting streamlined inventory management.
  • Energy Efficiency: Advanced insulation and cooling technology help lower operational costs by reducing energy consumption.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Food Storage: Ideal for commercial kitchens, food distributors, and specialty food retailers needing reliable cold storage for meats, dairy, or prepared foods.
  • Pharmaceuticals: Suitable for pharmacies and laboratories requiring precise temperature and humidity control for medications and biological samples.
  • Floral and Botanical Storage: Maintains optimal conditions for florists or botanical suppliers to preserve freshness and reduce waste.
  • Bulk Storage Needs: Perfect for businesses seeking large-capacity, controlled-environment storage for bulk perishable inventory.

User-Focused Answers

  • Durability: Built with high-quality materials and advanced insulation to ensure long-lasting, dependable operation in demanding environments.
  • Ease of Use: Adjustable shelves and straightforward controls make setup and daily operation user-friendly.
  • Compatibility: Designed to accommodate a wide range of product types and sizes, supporting diverse storage requirements.
  • Value: Delivers reliable performance and energy savings, making it a cost-effective choice for businesses prioritizing product quality and operational efficiency.

This cold storage unit is engineered to address the most common needs in commercial refrigeration, providing precise temperature and humidity control, ample storage space, and advanced preservation technology for a variety of industries.
